name: F.E. Walter Dam
public_profile: Location: Bear Creek Township, Luzerne County and Kidder Township, Carbon County, Pennsylvania
Purpose: flood control, water storage, recreation
Opened: 1961; operated by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
Type: earth-fill embankment with rock shell, impounding the Lehigh River
operation_target_description: Your goal is to keep the water level within the designated seasonal pool levels. From mid-October until late spring, keep the pool near the conservation pool at 1300.0 ft N.G.V.D. On or before 1 April, when hydrologic conditions allow, raise the pool toward 1370.0 ft N.G.V.D., the top of the temporary recreation pool, to reach it by early May. From May through mid-October, keep the pool at or below 1370.0 ft N.G.V.D. By mid-October, release any remaining stored water to return the pool to 1300.0 ft.
